name: Historic Jeddah, the Gate to Makkah
description: Al-Balad is the old walled heart of Jeddah, on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast. For centuries it was a busy port where Indian Ocean merchants traded and pilgrims landed on their way to Mecca. Its lanes are lined with tall merchant houses from the late 1800s, built of coral stone and fronted with carved wooden balcony windows called roshans.
